title: Pet-Friendly Hotels in Indianapolis, Indiana | PetTripFinder
meta_description: Verified pet-friendly hotels across the Indianapolis visitor market, with real pet fees and policies read from each hotel's own official website.
introductory_copy: Every listing links to a pet policy verified directly from the hotel's own official website.
_boundary_note: PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-MARKET-BUILD-001. Indianapolis visitor market, not municipal limits and not the entire MSA. Primary core and urban lodging corridors follow Visit Indy neighborhoods and the official IND airport lodging geography. Outer-ring Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville and Westfield are included because Visit Indy lists Hamilton County Tourism as a partner and sells Hamilton County lodging as Indianapolis-north stays; Plainfield, Avon and Brownsburg are included because Visit Hendricks County and the Indianapolis Airport Authority sell them as Indianapolis Airport lodging. Greenwood is included as the I-65 Indianapolis-South commercial lodging cluster. Festival Country Indiana (Franklin, Whiteland, Bargersville) remains a separately sold destination and is excluded. Zionsville, Anderson, Muncie, Bloomington, Columbus IN, Lafayette, Terre Haute, Richmond, Kokomo, Shelbyville, Greenfield beyond the east I-70 corridor, and Cincinnati-owned southeastern Indiana (Lawrenceburg, Aurora, Greendale, Rising Sun, Brookville; ZIPs 47001/47025/47040/47012) are excluded. Fountain-Fletcher is a Visit Indy neighborhood but has no official hotel inventory after B&Bs are set aside, so it is not a corridor. Shared ZIP 46202 is not registered to any corridor; those properties are assigned explicitly. This factory publishes zero hotels.
